title: urg-forecast-core: open base for forecasting Chilean emergency department demand from DEIS data
description: Open-source Python package and command-line tool that forecasts weekly emergency department attendances for any Chilean establishment from the public DEIS MINSAL Atenciones de Urgencia dataset: a DEIS client, weekly aggregation, a quantile Forecaster interface with statistical baselines, and a backtest harness with pinball-loss scoring. A starting point to build on, not a finished product.
